learning_objective: 🎯 Dive into the exciting world of economics and discover the four magical ingredients needed to create absolutely everything around us!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Whether you are baking a cake or building a smartphone, you cannot create something out of nothing. In economics, the resources needed to make goods and services are called the 'Factors of Production'.
In economics, 'Land' does not just mean the ground we walk on. It includes all natural resources provided by our planet, like water, forests, sunlight, and minerals hidden deep underground.

Labour is the human effort, both physical and mental, used in production. Capital refers to human-made tools, machinery, factories, and the money needed to start the work. You need both to turn raw materials into finished goods!

Enterprise is the special skill of an entrepreneur who brings Land, Labour, and Capital together. They take the risk to start a business, organize the work, and create a final product that people want to buy.

fun_activity.title: ⚡ The Lemonade Stand Plan
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you are opening a lemonade stand. Write down your 4 factors of production! Land (water, lemons), Capital (juicer, table, money), Labour (you mixing the drink), and Enterprise (your brilliant business idea)!

quick_recap: ⭐ Production is the process of combining different resources to create valuable goods and services.
⭐ The four key factors of production are Land, Labour, Capital, and Enterprise.
⭐ An entrepreneur plays a vital role by taking risks and organizing the other three factors.
